---
title: "01 - Load Data"
format: html
---

## Library Loading
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


## Raw Data Loading 
```{r}
mortality_raw <- read_csv(file = here("_raw/mortality_under5.csv"))
measles_raw <- read_csv(file = here("_raw/measles_immunization_1yo.csv"))
stunting_raw <- read_csv(file = here("_raw/stunting_prevelance_under5.csv"))
```

## Storing data in dedicated folder.
```{r}
write_tsv(x = mortality_raw, file = here("data/01_dat_mortality.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = measles_raw, file = here("data/01_dat_measles.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = stunting_raw, file = here("data/01_dat_stunting.tsv"))
```
